name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick chart
description: Candles print one by one while the camera rides the newest through a breakout.

props.name: data
props.doc: The candles, oldest first. Open, high, low, close.

props.name: startDate
props.doc: Date of the first candle, YYYY-MM-DD. Candles fall on weekdays.

props.name: palette
props.type: primary | monochrome | ocean | sunset | grove | vivid
props.doc: Chart palette: primary (indigo, yellow, fuchsia, mist, black), monochrome, ocean, sunset, grove or vivid.

props.name: format.group
props.doc: Thousands separator, a comma by default. Empty for none.

props.name: printSeconds
props.doc: How long the candles take to print.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: How long the last frame holds.

props.name: camera.tightZoom
props.doc: Zoom while riding the newest candle.

props.name: camera.lead
props.doc: Screen pixels the camera leads the newest candle by.

props.name: camera.motionBlur
props.doc: Strength of the motion blur on the fast moves; 0 turns it off.

props.name: camera.rackFocus
props.doc: Blur in pixels on the grid and labels while the shot is tight.

props.name: camera.drift
props.doc: Handheld drift in pixels on the holds.
